text:
acme_cto: Hey team — for the POC we need HSM-backed keys and customer-managed rotation. Can Redwood point to what you need from our side and any limitations?

emma_sales: Thanks! We'll run a BYO-KMS POC. Quick Qs: do you have an HSM provider (AWS CloudHSM, Azure Dedicated HSM, YubiHSM, etc.) and is FIPS 140-2/3 attestation required by your compliance team?

acme_cto: We use AWS CloudHSM and need FIPS 140-2 level compliance. Audit logs + key rotation proof are must-haves.

mike_solutions: Noted. Two things to flag up front: 1) BYO-KMS (HSM) is supported on Dedicated and Private deployments; hosted has a limited BYO option via envelope encryption — will confirm. 2) There's a BYO add-on for audit/attestation support and extra onboarding hours (security review) — I'll share pricing in a sec.

raj_infra: Tech bit — for the POC we typically ask for: an IAM role/service principal with Encrypt/Decrypt permissions, the KMS key ARN, and for CloudHSM: a test cluster endpoint or proxy creds. We'll do a quick integration that uses a local envelope key + our runtime calling your KMS for DEK unwrap.

lina_security: From security: we need the HSM cert bundle, rotation schedule, and a signed attestation or prefix of the FIPS report. Also need proof that key material never leaves HSM and that key rotation is customer-controlled.

acme_cto: We can provide the FIPS report and attestation. Rotation is monthly by policy, but we can also do on-demand.

mike_solutions: Pricing snapshot: BYO-KMS onboarding = one-time $6k (security review + attestation ingestion), BYO add-on = $1.5k/mo for audit ingestion + retention; Dedicated deployment pricing separate. I'll send a formal quote to the deal thread. Numbers provisional.

emma_sales: Timeline proposal: week 1 — kick off + creds exchange; week 2 — infra run by @raj_infra; week 3 — validation with your apps; week 4 — handoff and docs. Does that align with your internal schedule?

acme_cto: Yes, that's tight but doable. We'll provision a CloudHSM test cluster by Monday.

raj_infra: For the integration I'll need a sample rotation policy. For the POC we'll test monthly rotation and verify audits. Example config we'll use on our side:

```json
{
  "kms_provider": "aws-kms",
  "key_arn": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345",
  "use_hsm": true,
  "envelope_mode": true,
  "rotation": {
    "type": "customer-managed",
    "interval_days": "30"
  }
}
```

raj_infra: We'll run a test script that: create DEK locally -> call KMS Encrypt(key_arn, DEK) -> store ciphertext -> call KMS Decrypt -> validate. Will post logs in #eng-runtime.

lina_security: Also need to confirm: will Redwood surface KMS audit events into our SIEM (e.g., Splunk/Datadog) or do you push a copy to our audit bucket? Which method?

mike_solutions: We support both: forwarding audit events to your SIEM via a webhook or pushing JSON logs to your S3 audit bucket (preferred for air-gapped). For the POC we can push to a temporary S3 bucket you own.

acme_cto: S3 push works. We'll create a bucket with restricted access.

emma_sales: Action items: (1) @acme_cto to provide FIPS attestation + test CloudHSM creds by Mon. (2) @raj_infra to prepare POC scripts and confirm env. (3) @mike_solutions to draft BYO pricing addendum. (4) @lina_security to provide exact security checklist items we need to sign off.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] new deployment created: infra/poc-hsm-integration v1 -> staging at 2025-10-02T15:12:03Z

raj_infra: I'll start the run tomorrow. I'll post a short checklist in this thread with exact IAM policies required.

acme_cto: One more blocker from our side — legal wants an explicit clause about key custody and liabilities. Is there a standard SLAs/contract language Redwood uses for BYO-KMS?

mike_solutions: We have a BYO-KMS contract appendix that covers key custody, liability cap for key leakage (standard SaaS caps), and SOC2/FIPS references. I'll attach it to the deal doc and tag legal.

emma_sales: Great — I'll update the deal playbook and schedule a 30-min call with legal + security tomorrow. Thanks all :thumbsup:
